tip.til: til always takes the genitive: Við viljum fara til Íslands.
demo.data: Demo data until progress tracking arrives in Phase 5.
demo.lesson: This is the demo lesson. Your progress is not saved yet.
landing.say: "TÖL-va": Icelandic for computer, from tala (number) and völva (seeress).
landing.pitchTitle: Built for what makes Icelandic hard
landing.casesText: Every form comes from the Database of Icelandic Morphology. Endings are color-coded by case and always labeled, and every hint says why a case is used.
landing.soundsText: hv sounds like kv, ll like tl, and vowels can be long or short. Every item gets audio with a slow option, plus IPA where it exists.
landing.soundsExample: sl is said with a t in between: stl.
landing.bridgeText: Use the app in English or Norwegian Bokmål, read glosses in either, and spot the cognates and false friends you already know.
audio.none: No Icelandic voice on this device yet. Recorded and generated audio arrives in Phase 4.
charrow.label: Icelandic letters
ex.case: Which case is the marked word?
feedback.reason.letters+accents: Watch the special letters and the accents: {pairs}.
lesson.quitText: Your answers in this lesson will not be saved.
learn.guideSoon: Guidebooks with the grammar for each unit arrive in Phase 3.
decl.intro: Four cases, singular and plural, without and with the definite article. Tap a form to hear it, or switch on practice mode.
decl.caption: Declension of {lemma}
credit.bin: Forms: BÍN (DMII Core), Árni Magnússon Institute for Icelandic Studies. CC BY-SA 4.0, shown without changes.
credit.dict: Forms: BÍN (DMII Core). Meaning, IPA and etymology: Wiktionary, CC BY-SA 4.0. Examples: Tatoeba, CC BY 2.0 FR.
stories.intro: Short readings where every word is explained. Tap a word to see what it is doing in the sentence.
stories.pick: Tap any word to see its dictionary form, case and number.
stories.noData: No details for this word in the demo yet. In Phase 4 every word gets its lemma, meaning and full table.
dict.intro: Search a word or any of its forms. The demo knows hestur, bók and Ísland.
dict.placeholder: Search a word or a form
dict.none: Nothing found for "{q}" in the demo.
dict.noExamples: No example sentences in the demo yet.
dict.cognatesSoon: Cognate and false-friend hints arrive in Phase 7.
practice.intro: Replay what you missed and train the forms that trip you up.
practice.mistakesText: Replays the items you got wrong until they stick.
practice.casesText: Fill in declension tables, one ending at a time.
practice.lettersText: Type þ, ð, æ and ö until they feel normal.
practice.weakText: Accuracy by case, number and gender. Every cell shows its percentage, and the weakest ones are listed below.
profile.intro: Your progress is stored on this device only. There are no accounts.
profile.dataText: Export all progress as a file, or import it on another device. This arrives in Phase 5.
settings.intro: Changes apply right away and are saved on this device.
settings.calmHelp: Removes scanlines, glitch, pulsing and large glows. Auto follows your device's reduced motion and contrast settings.
settings.scanHelp: The CRT effect. Reading screens always use the low setting unless you turn it off.
settings.sfxHelp: Short 8-bit chimes for answers. Off by default.
settings.voiceHelp: Voices come from your browser and device. Recorded and generated audio arrives in Phase 4.
settings.noVoice: No Icelandic voice on this device
settings.strictHelp: Easy accepts missing accents as almost right. Strict counts them as wrong, because accents change words.
settings.heartsHelp: Lose a heart for each mistake. Off by default.
settings.glossHelp: Norwegian glosses appear where the data has them; otherwise English is shown.
credits.intro: TÖLVA is built on open data made by others. Thank you.
sg.toastText: A toast message, polite and short.
